submit_application.description: Submit a candidate's application to a job post on your own organization's Greenhouse job board, as your careers site's form would: name, email, phone, a resume and cover letter (a link Greenhouse downloads, or pasted text), answers to the post's questions, education, and employment. Needs your Job Board API key on the Greenhouse connection. The post's form is checked first, and an application missing a required answer isn't sent, since Greenhouse would accept it without one. Get the field names to answer with 'Get Greenhouse job' and 'Include application questions'.

submit_application.name: submit_application

parameters.description: The company's Greenhouse job board token, the last path segment of its board URL (e.g. 'anthropic' in https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/anthropic). Pasting the board or job post URL works too.

parameters.name: phone

parameters.name: resume_url

parameters.name: resume_filename

parameters.description: Optional. The resume pasted as plain text.
parameters.name: resume_text

parameters.description: Optional. A link Greenhouse can download the cover letter from (pdf, doc, docx, txt or rtf).

parameters.name: cover_letter_filename

parameters.description: Optional. Answers to the post's questions, keyed by each field's 'name' from 'Get Greenhouse job' with 'Include application questions' on. Text questions take text, a single select its option's 'value', a multi select a list of values, and a yes/no question true or false. EEOC fields such as 'gender' and 'veteran_status', 'demographic_answers', and location fields go here too.
parameters.name: answers

parameters.description: Optional. A list of schools, each with school_name_id, degree_id, and discipline_id (from 'List Greenhouse education options') and start_date and end_date as 'YYYY-MM' or {month, year}.
parameters.name: educations

parameters.name: employments

parameters.name: data_compliance

parameters.description: Optional. The 'gh_src' value from the link the applicant arrived by, which Greenhouse records as the application's source.
parameters.name: mapped_url_token

description: Read any company's public Greenhouse job board: list and search its open roles, newest first or since a date, pull a job post's full description, pay ranges and application questions, and browse its departments, offices, and prospect sections, with no API key.
